import type { CsvOptions, StatementRow } from '@fernpay/contracts';
import { escapeCell } from './escape';
import { isBlank } from './blank';


export function formatDescription(row: StatementRow): string {
  // TODO: escape the delimiter.
  return row.description == null ? '' : String(row.description);
}


export function formatReference(row: StatementRow): string {
  // TODO: escape the delimiter.
  return row.reference == null ? '' : String(row.reference);
}


export function formatCounterparty(row: StatementRow): string {
  return row.counterparty == null ? '' : String(row.counterparty);
}

}

}


export function formatBalance(row: StatementRow): string {
  return row.balance == null ? '' : String(row.balance);
}


export function formatPayoutId(row: StatementRow, options: CsvOptions): string {
  const value = row.payoutId;
  if (isBlank(value)) return options.empty;
  return escapeCell(String(value), options.delimiter);
}
